description: Header file defining interface for Microchip XEC external interrupt controller driver, specifically for ECIA (EC Interrupt Aggregator). It includes function declarations, callback types, and macros related to enabling, disabling, and managing interrupt sources and callbacks for GIRQ (Grouped Interrupt Request) lines.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_enable
methods.description: Enables a GIRQ interrupt for a specific source identified by girq_id and src.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_info_enable
methods.description: Enables an external interrupt line encoded with Ecia_info.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_disable
methods.description: Disables a GIRQ interrupt for a specific source.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_info_disable
methods.description: Disables an external interrupt line encoded with Ecia_info.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_set_callback
methods.description: Sets a callback for a specific GIRQ source.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_info_set_callback
methods.description: Sets a callback for a GIRQ connection encoded with Ecia_info.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_set_callback_by_dev
methods.description: Sets a callback for a GIRQ source using a device handle.

methods.name: mchp_ecia_unset_callback
methods.description: Unsets the callback for a specific GIRQ source.

methods.name: mchp_ecia_unset_callback_by_dev
methods.description: Unsets the callback for a GIRQ source using a device handle.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_girq_aggr_en
methods.description: Enables or disables aggregated GIRQ output.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_girq_src_clr
methods.description: Clears the latched source status bit for a GIRQ.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_girq_src_en
methods.description: Enables a source in a GIRQ.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_girq_src_dis
methods.description: Disables a source in a GIRQ.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_girq_src_clr_bitmap
methods.description: Clears multiple sources in a GIRQ based on a bitmap.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_girq_src_en_bitmap
methods.description: Enables multiple sources in a GIRQ based on a bitmap.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_girq_src_dis_bitmap
methods.description: Disables multiple sources in a GIRQ based on a bitmap.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_girq_result
methods.description: Reads the result register of a GIRQ.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_nvic_clr_pend
methods.description: Clears the pending status of an NVIC input.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_info_girq_aggr_en
methods.description: Enables or disables aggregated GIRQ output using encoded info.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_info_girq_src_clr
methods.description: Clears latched source status using encoded info.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_info_girq_src_en
methods.description: Enables a source in a GIRQ using encoded info.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_info_girq_src_dis
methods.description: Disables a source in a GIRQ using encoded info.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_info_girq_result
methods.description: Reads the result register for a GIRQ using encoded info.

methods.name: mchp_xec_ecia_info_nvic_clr_pend
methods.description: Clears NVIC pending status given encoded info.
